event_name: Time 03:00 2019 SINGAPORE GRAND PRIX 19 - 22 September 2019 The Stewards have received a request from Renault F1 Team to allow car 3 to start the race despite being disqualified from the results of qualifying (document 30). In accordance with Article 35.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, the Stewards grant permission for car 3, Daniel Ricciardo, to start the race, as the driver has set satisfactory times in practice at this Event.
